Re-read cheatman.cpp:127-385. parse_buf's else branch (:352) is reached for code lines and for lines that trim to empty; parse_line (:187-200) re-runs is_cheat_code and returns a zero code for the empty case, which the zero check at :355 then skips. term_str (:227-240) has one caller (:342) passing is_cmt_str, which calls strlen at every character. All are static; grep over src and .github finds no other users (test_cheat_capacity.py:25 slices make_code..read_text_file, unaffected). One correction to the fix: the make_code failure branch (:149-153) is unreachable rather than harmless, because make_code is only reached for lines with exactly CODE_DIGITS (16) hex digits, so sscanf always fills both fields; on a 1-field parse address would NOT stay 0.

corrected.fix: In parse_buf, call make_code directly when is_cheat_code(line) is true and skip the line otherwise; delete parse_line. In make_code delete the sscanf failure branch: its only caller passes lines holding exactly CODE_DIGITS hex digits, so both fields always parse. Replace term_str+is_cmt_str with one inline scan that cuts the line at the first '#' or '//'.

verdicts.note: Re-read cheatman.cpp:387-507 and supportbase.cpp:1730-1845, bdmlaunch.cpp:885-896, host.cpp:154-158, supportbase.cpp:1847-1876. read_text_file's only caller passes 0 (:476), so :411-415 is dead; confirmed. But the claim that the order change is harmless is wrong: load_cheats now calls ensureCheatTable first (:472), which zeroes the table even when the file then fails to read. gCheats survives for the session (a launch that fails back to the GUI keeps it), and after a cheat-load failure a launch can still continue (sbCheatsMissingContinue returns 1 on autolaunch or the all-games default; bdmlaunch.cpp:890-894) and fillCoreConfig calls set_cheats_list (host.cpp:156), which flattens whatever gCheats holds. Reading first and only clearing in load_cheats_buf would leave the previous game's cheats in the table on a missing file. The fix must keep the clear on a failed read.

corrected.problem: read_text_file's only caller passes maxsize 0 (:476), so the size-limit branch (:411-415) is dead. load_cheats (:467-489) repeats load_cheats_buf's ensureCheatTable/parse_buf/mode-return sequence (:495-507).
corrected.fix: Drop the maxsize parameter and its branch. In load_cheats_buf call ensureCheatTable before the NULL test, so a NULL buffer still clears the table; then make load_cheats read the file, call load_cheats_buf(buf), free the buffer and return that result. Do not simply read first and clear later: a failed read must still leave an empty table, or set_cheats_list (host.cpp:156) can flatten the previous game's cheats on a launch that continues past the error.
corrected.evidence: grep read_text_file in src: cheatman.cpp:388,393,476 only. load_cheats called at supportbase.cpp:1811, load_cheats_buf at supportbase.cpp:1779. A failed load can still launch: sbCheatsMissingContinue (supportbase.cpp:1667-1680) continues on autolaunch and the all-games default; bdmlaunch.cpp:890-894; host.cpp:154-158 then calls set_cheats_list, which reads gCheats whenever it is non-NULL (cheatman.cpp:518-534). test_cheat_capacity.py:25 anchors on 'static inline char *read_text_file(', which the change keeps.
